data.name: Furayjah
data.gender_notes: Furayjah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Furayjah is a name that symbolizes joy, happiness, and delight. It is derived from the root word 'Frayj' which means to be happy and rejoice. The name Furayjah carries the meaning “Joyfulness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Furayjah usually hope their child will grow to embody joyfulness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Furayjah is associated with the virtue of patience and perseverance.
data.etymology: Furayjah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joyfulness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Furayjah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
